subject: Renewal: operational SLA upgrade + short-term burst for Q2
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aureaanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@aureaanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — looking for premium SLA + short-term burst

Sergio,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal is coming up May 1 and we need to discuss a tighter latency SLO and a short Q2 burst to prepare for an upcoming campaign. High level asks: 
- Move to a premium SLA with 99.95% availability and 95th percentile latency target of <120ms for text-gen endpoints.
- Temporary 2x burst capacity for 6 weeks (estimated 300M tokens/week peak).
- A documented escalation path and 24x7 phone on-call for critical incidents.

We'd like to understand pricing impact and a clear operational plan (Mutual Action Plan). Can you share a proposed approach and any supporting docs?

Thanks,
Maria
Head of Platform Ops
Aurea Analytics

Attachments: none
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aureaanalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — looking for premium SLA + short-term burst

Maria — thanks for the clear ask. High-level response below and I attached a draft SLA addendum + MAP workbook for Q2 planning.

Summary proposal (first pass):
- Premium SLA: 99.95% uptime, 95th %ile latency objective of 115ms for text-gen on the dedicated model tier you run now.
- Burst: reserved burst pool for 6 weeks, pre-warmed nodes + buffer capacity; estimated cost uplift ~28% for the quarter, with overage cap.
- Ops: 24/7 critical incident line + a named escalation engineer during the burst period.

Next steps I propose:
1) We fill out the MutualActionPlan_Aurea_Q2.xlsx together with exact traffic curves.
2) Pricing: Vanessa will confirm discounting/credit structure tied to a 12-month renewal.
3) Legal: we will produce a short SLA addendum you can attach to the master agreement.

I attached SLA_Addendum_Aurea_v1.pdf and the MAP workbook. If this aligns, I can loop legal and start an expedited DocuSign for the addendum and quote.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SLA_Addendum_Aurea_v1.pdf (draft), MutualActionPlan_Aurea_Q2.xlsx (workbook)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — pricing/credits for burst

Team — quick coordination. Points I think we should lock before sending final quote:

- Pricing model: Recommend a two-part approach — (A) baseline renewal rate for committed capacity, (B) a burst bucket priced and capped. For Q2 burst, offer a 20% prepay credit that is refundable as usage credit if not consumed.
- SLA: Legal will accept the 99.95% target + incident phone line for the burst window only if we include structured runbook attachments and 4-week testing window pre-burst. Addendum should call out measured latency windows (p95/p95.5) and a punchlist for runbook handoff.
- Margin: Marcus — will a 20% prepay still meet our target margin? If not, propose 22% uplift.

Vanessa — can you confirm commercial flexibility (discounting tied to a 12-month renewal and commitment to dedicated pool)?
Marcus — ping on margin numbers by EOD so we can finalize the Quote_DL-2027-4817.pdf.

Grace
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
